meta.name: design-system-compliance
meta.description: Check that the UI you actually rendered uses the design system, by reading computed styles in the running app against the project's design tokens. Catches hardcoded hex colors, off-palette backgrounds, invisible or unusable controls, and animations that never ran. Use after building or restyling a component, when a design review is wanted, when a UI looks slightly off but nobody can say why, or when a design system exists and nothing checks whether the code follows it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照设计规范检查页面真实渲染样式,揪出跑偏的颜色与失效的控件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你已有设计规范,却没人检查代码是否真的照着用
copy.tagline_en: Check rendered UI against your design tokens to flag off-palette colors
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a design system and nothing verifies the code follows it

howto.what: 它会读取运行中页面的计算样式，与项目的 design token 对比，逐元素报告不符合的颜色、被遮挡或不可见的控件，以及没跑起来的动画，并给出 file:line 位置。
howto.when: 当你构建或改完组件样式、想做设计评审、或觉得 UI 有点不对却说不上来时触发；项目已有设计系统但没人检查代码是否遵循时也用它。

say.text: 帮我检查刚改的这个组件有没有用设计 token
say.note: 读取运行页面的计算样式，逐元素报告违规项

say.text: 这个页面上哪些颜色不在调色板里？
say.note: 给出 offTheme 元素和对应 file:line

say.text: 我加的那个动画为什么没有跑起来？
say.note: 列出运行中和刚结束的动画，缺了就说明没跑

howto.what_en: It reads computed styles in the running page and compares them against the project's design tokens, reporting off-palette colors, occluded or invisible controls, and animations that never ran, each with a file:line.
howto.when_en: Use after building or restyling a component, when a design review is wanted, or when a UI looks slightly off but nobody can say why.

say_en.text: Check whether the component I just restyled uses the design tokens
say_en.note: Reads computed styles in the running page and reports violations

say_en.text: Which colors on this page are not in the palette?
say_en.note: Returns the offTheme elements with their file:line

say_en.text: Why didn't the animation I added run?
say_en.note: Lists running and recent animations; missing means it never ran
